records.title: Registered CAP-CDS — source-scoped capability profiles

profiles.scope: CDS owns patient-specific recommendation proposals, including clinical pathways, preventive screening, surgical planning, precision treatment and digital therapy proposals. Medication, genomic results and actual treatment remain their source owners. These distinct profiles do not constitute one approved algorithm or autonomous treatment authority. Pediatric proposals retain developmental stage and guardian/assent context.

CDS owns explicit advisory diagnosis/ranking, guideline conflict handling, clinical prioritization and treatment/prevention proposals. Final safety validator and autonomous intelligence are source labels, not approval or autonomy. Rule execution yields a versioned proposal and reasons for review; actual prescribing, ventilation settings, disposition, orders and scheduling remain controlled by qualified workflow owners.

records.title: Registered CAP-INTEROP — source-scoped capability profiles

profiles.scope: Interoperability owns versioned exchange and terminology mappings with actual partner/source attribution. Ontology equivalence, unit conversion, code suggestions and standard names are not conformance certification. Preserve original codes/units and unresolved or lossy mappings; gateways cannot broaden authorization or combine identities by similarity.

records.title: Registered CAP-DEVICES — source-scoped capability profiles

profiles.scope: Devices owns equipment identity, status, maintenance/calibration history, availability and home-device connector context. Predictions remain attributed AI artifacts; a reported working status is not calibration proof or permission to operate/program a device.

Devices owns circulatory/ventilation/ECMO and wearable/CGM equipment identity, settings/exposure history and integration context. Protocols and clinical weaning/therapy decisions are references to clinician-controlled workflows; this profile does not implement a medical-device controller. AI detection and time-in-range are derived measures with raw-data provenance.
